## About
Denton Sports Chiropractic is an all-woman team on W Hickory St in Denton. We're not just about the adjustments. Our mission is to keep you active, pain-free, and loving life, in a fun and welcoming atmosphere.
Dr. Crystal Hankel is the DSC owner. She played collegiate softball at Texas Woman's University, went on to Parker University in Dallas, and is a Certified Chiropractic Sports Physician. Dr. Maggie Norcross grew up playing soccer and studied at Texas A&M University and Parker University. Deja Morrow, our office manager, keeps the schedule running.
We treat serious athletes, weekend warriors, pregnant mamas, and anyone working toward better health. You'll always know the what, why, and how of your treatments.

## Services
- Chiropractic Care: Adjustments that help balance your spine so your nerves and muscles can work the way they should.
- Dry Needling: We target trigger points to help tight muscles relax and boost blood flow.
- IASTM Therapy: Instrument work that smooths out stubborn knots and tension so healthy tissue can take over.
- Massage Therapy: Massage that goes past relaxation to reduce pain and improve range of motion and circulation.
- Cupping: Gets blood flowing, helps bring inflammation down, and lets tight muscles let go.
- MyACT: Acoustic waves aimed right at the tissue that needs it, like a targeted deep tissue massage.
- Assisted Stretching: We guide you through stretches that build mobility and flexibility.
- Corrective Exercise: We find and fix the muscle imbalances that throw off your posture and stability.

## FAQ
Q: Who do you treat?
A: Serious athletes, weekend warriors, pregnant mamas, and anyone making positive changes toward better health.

Q: What does a visit include?
A: It depends on you. We combine chiropractic adjustments, soft tissue work, and corrective exercises in a plan built around your goals.

Q: I've never been to a chiropractor. Is this a good place to start?
A: One reviewer who has been coming for years put it this way: if you're hesitant to try chiropractic, this is the best place to start.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday and Wednesday 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Tuesday and Thursday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Friday 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

## What customers say
- "If you’re searching for a chiropractor who truly listens, looks beyond the obvious, and treats the source of your pain—not just the symptoms—go see Crystal at Denton Sports Chiropractic.

I first visited Crystal about 10 years ago after a friend insisted that I make an appointment. I was in my early 20s and experiencing such severe lower-back pain that I could barely walk or even sit comfortably. My general practitioner referred me to a general surgeon, but after X-rays and consultations, no one could determine what was wrong.

Within the first few minutes of meeting me, Crystal identified the issue: a highly curved tailbone. She used a combination of adjustments, dry needling, and cupping, and sent me home with exercises and aftercare instructions. I returned for a second visit the following week, and within two weeks, I was back to normal.

I’ve now trusted Crystal with my care for a decade. Whether I’ve popped a rib out of place, hurt my neck, or thrown out my back, she has always done everything she can to fit me into her already-busy schedule and help me recover.

Crystal’s bubbly personality immediately makes you feel comfortable enough to explain exactly what you’re experiencing. More importantly, she genuinely listens instead of making assumptions. She is incredibly knowledgeable, explains why you’re experiencing pain in a way that is easy to understand, and creates a personalized treatment plan that may include far more than a traditional chiropractic adjustment.

Crystal has truly been a lifesaver for me, and I recommend her and Denton Sports Chiropractic anytime I hear someone mention needing a chiropractor. After 10 years of exceptional care, I can confidently say there is no one I trust more." (Jordan Karnes, 5/5)
